$comment: The FocuSD Island plugin protocol: JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio, one message per line. This file is the source of truth; src-tauri/src/plugin_host/tests.rs checks the host against it and docs/plugins/README.md describes it for people. 'since' is the plugin API version (manifest apiVersion) that introduced the item; 'capability' names the entry in initialize.capabilities that says the host has it.

events.name: todos.changed
events.payload: { date }; call todos.list for the todos

events.name: note.changed
events.payload: { date }; call note.get for the text

methods.name: settings.get
methods.result: Every declared setting with its current value (defaults filled in).

params.items: [{ label: LocalizedText, value: string (max 500 chars), copy?: boolean, secret?: boolean }] (max 10; empty clears)

methods.name: events.subscribe

params.events: [string] (max 16; each needs the event's permission; all are checked before any is applied)

methods.result: { events }: every event the plugin is subscribed to, sorted

methods.name: storage.get
methods.result: { value }: null when the key is not set

params.value: any JSON (max 64 KB as JSON; the plugin's whole storage max 1 MB, else status 413)

params.title: string
params.date?: YYYY-MM-DD; later than today goes to the 'later' list

methods.name: agentStatus.report
methods.result: The saved status; id is '<plugin id>/<source>'.

params.source?: string; omitted clears every source of the plugin

methods.name: island.notify
methods.result: { muted }: true when the user turned this plugin's messages off (nothing is shown). At most 6 per minute per plugin, else -32000 with status 429.

params.value: string (max 1024 chars); at most 32 secrets per plugin (status 413)

toPlugin.name: initialize
toPlugin.params: { apiVersion, capabilities (since 2), appVersion, pluginId, dataDir, permissions, settings }

toPlugin.name: event
toPlugin.params: { name, payload }; at most one per event name every 200 ms, carrying the latest payload. Subscriptions end when the process exits.

toPlugin.name: notification.action
toPlugin.params: { id }: the user clicked that button of an island.notify message

errors.meaning: The plugin was not given the permission the method needs.

The island answered with an error; data.status is 400 bad params, 404 not found, 413 too large, 429 too many requests, 500 the host could not do it (e.g. a file or the Credential Manager failed), 504 no answer in time.
